description: Defines the ITextToSpeech interface, including configuration, speech states, error details, and notification callbacks for a Text-to-Speech system within the WPEFramework. It declares methods for controlling TTS features such as enabling/disabling, configuration, voice listing, speech control, and event notifications.
external_methods: Core::hresult RegisterWithCallsign(const string callsign, ITextToSpeech::INotification* sink)
Core::hresult SetFallbackText(const string scenario, const string value)
Core::hresult SetACL(const string method, const string apps)
Core::hresult ListVoices(const string language, RPC::IStringIterator*& voices) const
Core::hresult Speak(const string callsign, const string text, uint32_t &speechid, TTSErrorDetail &status)
